zoe-docs: Heads-up: my docs PR (#441) failed docs CI with duplicate anchor errors and two images 404 on the runner. Works locally on macOS. Anyone seen this cross-OS weirdness? linkbot: linkbot: docs-site build failed: Error: duplicate anchor 'api-quickstart' at /docs/api/quickstart.md:33 devon-web: Usually this is slug normalization. Emojis, zero-width chars, or different unicode handling can collapse two headings to the same slug. zoe-docs: I inspected the file and there's an emoji heading and a normal heading: "🚀 API Quickstart" and "API Quickstart". Both render fine on GitHub but Docusaurus is unhappy on CI. sam-infra: CI runs inside a linux container with a different ICU/Node behavior. Two immediate fixes: (a) add an explicit id on the problematic heading, e.g. `

🚀 API Quickstart

`, or (b) switch docusaurus slugify to github-slugger so anchors match GitHub. zoe-docs: For the images, they were symlinked from `/shared/diagrams/`. CI tar/checkout doesn't include symlink targets so they 404. Thoughts? sam-infra: Short-term: vendor-copy the two diagrams into `docs/static/img/` in the PR. Long-term: update the workflow to dereference symlinks before build: `rsync -aL docs/static/ build/static/` or add `actions/checkout` with submodules if relevant. devon-web: Also add `remark-unique-headers` + `remark-slug` to docs lints so duplicate anchors cause a lint error pre-merge. It helped us catch these earlier. qa-bot: qa-bot: linkcheck: 2 broken links, 2 missing images (/static/img/flow.png, /static/img/overview.svg). zoe-docs: Plan: (1) vendor-copy diagrams for this PR, (2) add explicit id to the emoji heading, (3) open follow-up to change slugify to github-slugger and add the unique-headers lint, (4) file an infra issue to rsync symlinks in CI. Will ping when PR is up. devon-web: Sounds good. If you want I can help land the slug config change after we smoke-test it on a branch. sam-infra: I'll draft a tiny workflow change that prints the offending file+line for duplicate anchors to make reviewers' life easier. zoe-docs: Thanks all — opening the PR now. Ping me if you want to review the quick fixes. :thumbsup:
